programs.description: Mr Snail explores grass in a garden and meets a great grasshopper, who is hiding from lizards, and discovers how his green colour helps him hide.

programs.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
programs.subtitle: Amusement park
programs.description: Lale and Lolu find themselves in a magical amusement park.

programs.title: Pix & Leo
programs.subtitle: Sleepy Leo
programs.description: Pix wants to play, but sleepy Leo doesn't want to wake up. No matter how hard Pix tries, Leo is intent on napping. Will Leo finally wake up to play?

programs.title: Maya and Yaya
programs.subtitle: A Fly
programs.description: Maya and Yaya have a wonderful time playing with a ball until it gets stuck in a banana tree. The pair try to work on how to get it down.

programs.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
programs.subtitle: The Puzzled Planter
programs.description: A planter arrives on Zeina's doorstep, and she forgets what it is for. In their search for the answer, Zeina and her best friend Roy discover an original use for the object.

programs.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
programs.subtitle: A Pan's Adventure
programs.description: A pan arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that a pan is used for playing tennis... is it?

programs.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
programs.subtitle: A Pencil's Curious Quest
programs.description: Zeina receives a pencil, but she has forgotten what you use a pencil for.

programs.title: Mike's Bike
programs.subtitle: Johnny and the Kite
programs.description: Johnny wants to ride his bike and fly his kite at the same time, but it is no easy task. Luckily, Mikey is there to offer some assistance.

programs.title: Mike's Bike
programs.subtitle: Bike Puzzle
programs.description: Johnny has taken apart his bicycle but can't seem to put it back together again. He turns to his good friend Mikey for some help.

programs.title: Mona & Sketch
programs.subtitle: Animal Doctor
programs.description: Mona and Sketch set out to become animal doctors and help fix Butterfly's torn wing.

programs.title: Mona & Sketch
programs.subtitle: Astronaute
programs.description: Mona and Sketch set out on an adventure to become astronauts. Sketch scribbles stars and a spaceship to travel to space. They use a fan to sprinkle stardust on a star to make it twinkle.

programs.title: Mona & Sketch
programs.subtitle: Painter
programs.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out on an adventure to become painters! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a paintbrush and paints! What's missing? A painter's overalls, of course! Colour a picture and get covered with l…

programs.title: Billy Bam-Bam
programs.subtitle: Train
programs.description: Billy and Bam-Bam have a wonderful time together eating tasty strawberries and cream.

programs.title: Billy Bam-Bam
programs.subtitle: Cymbals
programs.description: Billy and Bam-Bam have a lovely time using pan lids as cymbals, singing and dancing in their band.

programs.title: Tiny Bunch
programs.subtitle: Magic Tricks
programs.description: Rabbit is great at doing magic tricks, but it remains to be seen if Baby Butterfly will also be able to become a true magician. Either way, together, they have fun pulling surprises out of hats.

programs.title: Tiny Bunch
programs.subtitle: Baby Sleeps Over At Squirrel's House
programs.description: The Baby Butterfly and its animal friends remember funny times together. Together, they can overcome all problems because they know that the most important thing is their friendship.

programs.title: Tiny Bunch
programs.subtitle: Giraffe's Sore Throat
programs.description: Giraffe has a sore throat and can't come out to play. Baby, Squirrel and Rabbit try to help with some tea and soup.

programs.title: Bath Tubbies
programs.subtitle: Bubbles
programs.description: Froggy and Ellie have fun in the bathtub blowing a flower and fish out of soap bubbles, and Ducky wants to join them but must figure out how he is going to reach them.

programs.title: Bath Tubbies
programs.subtitle: Splish Splash
programs.description: Froggy is blowing soap bubbles in the bathtub and wants to find out who is spraying water on him, but Ellie is playing ball while Ducky is sleeping on a mattress.

programs.title: Bath Tubbies
programs.subtitle: Paint Splashes
programs.description: Ellie and Ducky are having fun playing with paint, but Ellie must clean themselves up in the bath as they cannot go to sleep covered with paint splashes.

programs.title: Look What I Found
programs.subtitle: Hot Air Balloon
programs.description: The green ball turns into an amazing hot air balloon. The friends take a fun ride, seeing the small houses and trees from high above while they float on fluffy clouds and slide down a sparkling rainbow.

programs.title: Look What I Found
programs.subtitle: Riding a Shoe
programs.description: The friends as they set out on a fantastic journey in a shoe that turns into a car. They enjoy the fun ride, stop at the railroad crossing, and see the train go by before saying hello to the sheep.

programs.title: Look What I Found
programs.subtitle: Outer Space
programs.description: The friends use a cardboard box as a rocket ship, setting out on an exciting adventure into outer space, flying among comets, planets, and stars, and see the entire world from above.

programs.title: Cuddlies
programs.subtitle: Eating Lunch

programs.title: Cuddlies
